records.jp: 作ろうと思っていた料理のレシピが思い出せなくて……^00レシピ本がありそうな場所に案内してもらえませんか？
records.en_original: There's something I'd like to cook, but I can't remember the recipe for the life of me... Do you know where I may be able to find a cookbook?
records.en_auxiliary: There's something I'd like to cook, but I can't remember the recipe for the life of me... Do you know where I may be able to find a cookbook?
records.en: I can't remember the recipe for something I wanted to make...^00Could you show me somewhere that might have a cookbook?

records.jp: なんとなくフレーズが頭に浮かぶんだけど、^00タイトルが思い出せない曲があって……。^00その正体を知りたいんだけど、^00ＣＤがたくさんある場所ってあるかな？
records.en_original: I'm trying to remember the title to this song, but I just can't... Is there any place with a bunch of CD's where I could look for it?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm trying to remember the title to this song, but I just can't... Is there any place with a bunch of CD's where I could look for it?
records.en: A melody keeps popping into my head,^00but I can't remember the song's title...^00I want to figure out what it is.^00Is there anywhere with lots of CDs?

records.jp: ない！　ない！　食材がなーい！！^00蓄えてた風船キャベツがすっからかんだよ！^00急いで補充してきて！　頼んだよ！
records.en_original: Our food! This is terrible! We're all out of <CLRE>Balloon Cabbage<CLNR>! Hurry and go get more! I'm counting on you!
records.en_auxiliary: Our food! This is terrible! We're all out of <CLRE>Balloon Cabbage<CLNR>! Hurry and go get more! I'm counting on you!
records.en: No! No! We're out of ingredients!!^00We've completely run out of <CLRE>Balloon Cabbage<CLNR>!^00Hurry and restock it! I'm counting on you!

records.jp: この間見かけた虹色の野菜……^00どんな味がするのかな？　気になるなあ……
records.en_original: I saw a rainbow-colored veggie the other day... I wonder what it tastes like?
records.en_auxiliary: I saw a rainbow-colored veggie the other day... I wonder what it tastes like?
records.en: That rainbow-colored vegetable I saw the other day...^00I wonder what it tastes like. I'm so curious...

records.jp: 最近、軽いものしか食べてないせいか、^00なんだか元気が出なくって……^00たまにはしっかり食べたいなあ
records.en_original: I've been trying to eat lighter recently, but I have almost no energy... Sometimes I want to have a nice, big meal.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been trying to eat lighter recently, but I have almost no energy... Sometimes I want to have a nice, big meal.
records.en: Maybe it's because I've only been eating light meals lately,^00but I just can't seem to get my energy back...^00I'd like a proper meal for once.

records.jp: 素材が必要なんだけど、モンスターが持ってて^00あたしじゃちょっと厳しいんだよねえ……^00代わりにとってきてもらえる？
records.en_original: I need some materials, but they're only held by demons... I can't fight, so I can't get them myself... Would you mind helping me out?
records.en_auxiliary: I need some materials, but they're only held by demons... I can't fight, so I can't get them myself... Would you mind helping me out?
records.en: I need some materials, but the monsters have them,^00and they're a little too much for me...^00Could you get them for me?

records.jp: 星崎さん。^00あなたの戦い方、見ててハラハラする。^00もう少し安定した戦い方をして欲しいんだけど……^00できるっていうなら、実際に証明して見せて
records.en_original: Hoshizaki. Watching you fight drives me crazy. Your fighting style needs to be steadier and more consistent. If you think you can do that, then prove it to me.
records.en_auxiliary: Hoshizaki. Watching you fight drives me crazy. Your fighting style needs to be steadier and more consistent. If you think you can do that, then prove it to me.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san.^00Watching you fight makes me nervous.^00I want you to fight a little more consistently...^00If you say you can, prove it.

records.jp: 素材集めの邪魔になってるモンスターがいて、^00あなたに倒してきて欲しい。^00……もちろん、私一人でも倒せるけど、^00あなたが得意なタイプの敵みたいだから。^00その方が効率的でしょ？
records.en_original: There's a demon getting in the way of my material gathering. I need you to go take it out. ...I'd do it myself, but it seems like the type you're better equipped at dealing with.
records.en_auxiliary: There's a demon getting in the way of my material gathering. I need you to go take it out. ...I'd do it myself, but it seems like the type you're better equipped at dealing with.
records.en: There's a monster getting in the way of gathering materials,^00and I want you to take it out.^00...Of course, I could defeat it alone,^00but it seems like the kind of enemy you're good against.^00That would be more efficient, wouldn't it?

records.jp: ここに来てから戦ったりしてるけど、^00昔に比べると身体が鈍ってる気がするんだよね。^00勘を取り戻すためにもっと頑張らないと！^00愛央も付き合ってくれない？
records.en_original: I've fought a good amount since I came here, I feel like my body is slower than it used to be. I need to work harder to get my form back! Will you help me, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: I've fought a good amount since I came here, I feel like my body is slower than it used to be. I need to work harder to get my form back! Will you help me, Ao?
records.en: I've fought since coming here,^00but my body feels duller than it used to.^00I need to work harder to get my instincts back!^00Will you train with me, Ao?

records.jp: いつも暑いよねー……^00せっかくなら、バカンス気分で暑さも楽しみたい！^00ってことで、^00南国っぽいパラソルとチェア、作ってみよう！
records.en_original: It sure is hot, huh? Let's make the most of it! I say we make an umbrella and chair and live our tropical fantasy!
records.en_auxiliary: It sure is hot, huh? Let's make the most of it! I say we make an umbrella and chair and live our tropical fantasy!
records.en: It's always so hot...^00We might as well enjoy it like we're on vacation!^00So,^00let's make a tropical parasol and chair!

records.jp: そんなに教室で勉強するのが嫌なら、^00外に机と椅子を置いて、そこで勉強しよ。^00青空の下で勉強するのは、さぞ楽しいでしょうね？
records.en_original: If you hate studying in the classroom so much, why not take your desk outside and study there? It's more fun to study under the great blue sky, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: If you hate studying in the classroom so much, why not take your desk outside and study there? It's more fun to study under the great blue sky, isn't it?
records.en: If you hate studying in the classroom that much,^00let's put a desk and chair outside and study there.^00I'm sure studying under the open sky will be great, won't it?

records.jp: 大きな樹があれば、目印にもなるし、^00もたれて休んだりもできるし……^00それに……ううん、何でもない
records.en_original: Not only would a big tree make a good landmark, we could sit under it and relax, maybe even—no, never mind.
records.en_auxiliary: Not only would a big tree make a good landmark, we could sit under it and relax, maybe even—no, never mind.
records.en: A big tree would make a good landmark,^00and we could lean against it to rest...^00And... No, never mind.

records.jp: 飲み物だけじゃなくて、^00食べ物の自販機もあったらいいなあ。^00ちょっと健康に悪そうだけど……少しならいいよね？
records.en_original: I wish we had a vending machine that sold food, not just drinks. I know it sounds a bit unhealthy, but...it couldn't hurt from time to time, right?
records.en_auxiliary: I wish we had a vending machine that sold food, not just drinks. I know it sounds a bit unhealthy, but...it couldn't hurt from time to time, right?
records.en: I wish we had a vending machine for food,^00not just drinks.^00It might not be very healthy... but a little won't hurt, right?

records.jp: 外で拾った植物の種……^00このまま腐らせるのは勿体ないよね。^00それに、この学校にも少しは彩りが欲しいと思わない？
records.en_original: I picked up some plant seeds outside... It would be a shame to just let them go to waste. Don't you think this school could use a little color?
records.en_auxiliary: I picked up some plant seeds outside... It would be a shame to just let them go to waste. Don't you think this school could use a little color?
records.en: Those plant seeds I picked up outside...^00It would be a shame to let them rot.^00And don't you think this school could use a little color?

records.jp: 林間学校とかでやるキャンプファイヤーって、^00どんな感じなんだろう。^00もしできるなら、みんなと一緒にやってみたいな
records.en_original: I've always wanted to try building a big bonfire like they have at those summer camps. It'd be nice if we could do one with everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: I've always wanted to try building a big bonfire like they have at those summer camps. It'd be nice if we could do one with everyone.
records.en: I wonder what the campfires on school camping trips are like.^00If we can,^00I'd like to try one with everyone.

records.jp: この世界に生えている葉っぱ……^00あれを使えば、誰も飲んだことがない^00未知の紅茶を淹れられると思うんです。^00一緒に挑戦してみませんか？
records.en_original: I think I may be able to use some of the leaves that grow in this world to brew a team no one has ever tasted before! Would you like to try it with me?
records.en_auxiliary: I think I may be able to use some of the leaves that grow in this world to brew a team no one has ever tasted before! Would you like to try it with me?
records.en: Those leaves growing in this world...^00I think we could use them to brew^00a tea no one has ever tasted before.^00Would you like to try it with me?

records.jp: わたしの料理、何かが足りないと思いませんか？^00食卓にも何か新しい刺激が必要だと思うんです
records.en_original: I feel like there's something missing in my cooking. It's time to put something new and exciting on the table.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel like there's something missing in my cooking. It's time to put something new and exciting on the table.
records.en: Don't you think something's missing from my cooking?^00I think our meals could use something new and exciting.

records.jp: ちょっとあたしの「芸術活動」に協力してくれない？^00愛央以外には怒られそうで頼めな……^00じゃなくて、愛央にしか頼めないんだよー！^00お願い！
records.en_original: Ao, can you help me out with my art project? Everyone else got mad when I—I mean you're the only one who can help!
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, can you help me out with my art project? Everyone else got mad when I—I mean you're the only one who can help!
records.en: Could you help with my 'artistic activities'?^00I can't ask anyone but Ao or they'll get mad...^00I-I mean, Ao's the only one I can ask!^00Please!

records.jp: うーん……^00中々思い出せません……
records.en_original: Hmm... I can't seem to remember....
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I can't seem to remember....
records.en: Hmm...^00I still can't remember...

records.jp: ふんふんふーん……♪
records.en_original: Hmm, hmm, hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, hmm, hmm...
records.en: Hmm-hmm-hmm...♪

records.jp: ない！　ない！　食材がなーい！！^00蓄えてた風船キャベツがすっからかんだよ！^00急いで補充してきて！　頼んだよ！
records.en_original: Our food! This is terrible! We're all out of Balloon Cabbage! Hurry and go get more! I'm counting on you!^00 ^00Main Collection Area: The Faraway.
records.en_auxiliary: Our food! This is terrible! We're all out of Balloon Cabbage! Hurry and go get more! I'm counting on you!^00 ^00Main Collection Area: The Faraway.
records.en: No! No! We're out of ingredients!!^00We've completely run out of Balloon Cabbage!^00Hurry and restock it! I'm counting on you!

records.jp: んー……どんな味がするんだろう……
records.en_original: Hmm... I wonder how it tastes...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I wonder how it tastes...
records.en: Hmm... I wonder what it tastes like...

records.jp: ……はあ。なんか調子でないなあ
records.en_original: *Sigh*... I'm feeling a little off.
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*... I'm feeling a little off.
records.en: *Sigh*... I just can't get my energy up.

records.jp: ちょっと手伝って欲しいんだけどー
records.en_original: Ao! I need your help with something!
records.en_auxiliary: Ao! I need your help with something!
records.en: I need a little help...

records.jp: ……星崎さん。ちょっといい？
records.en_original: Do you have a moment, Hoshizaki?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you have a moment, Hoshizaki?
records.en: ...Hoshizaki-san. Do you have a minute?

records.jp: ちょっと頼みたいことがあるんだけど
records.en_original: I have a favor to ask.
records.en_auxiliary: I have a favor to ask.
records.en: I have a favor to ask.

records.jp: うーん……まだ身体が思うように動かないな
records.en_original: Mm... My body still won't move like it used to.
records.en_auxiliary: Mm... My body still won't move like it used to.
records.en: Hmm... My body still won't move the way I want it to.

records.jp: 今日も暑いねえ。南の島にいるみたい。^00そうだ、南の島っていえば……
records.en_original: It's so hot... What is this, a tropical island or something? Wait a minute...
records.en_auxiliary: It's so hot... What is this, a tropical island or something? Wait a minute...
records.en: It's hot again today. It feels like a tropical island.^00Speaking of tropical islands...

records.jp: 星崎さん、勉強……^00何で逃げるの
records.en_original: Hoshizaki, why are you trying to get out of studying...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hoshizaki, why are you trying to get out of studying...?
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, your studies...^00Why are you running away?

records.jp: もし学校に樹を植えたら……
records.en_original: Maybe if we planted a tree...
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe if we planted a tree...
records.en: Maybe if we planted a tree...

records.jp: 喉、かわいたなあ。^00もっといろんな飲み物があったら……
records.en_original: I'm thirsty. I wish we had more kinds of drinks to choose from...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm thirsty. I wish we had more kinds of drinks to choose from...
records.en: I'm thirsty...^00I wish we had more kinds of drinks...

records.jp: 外で拾ってきた植物の種、どうしようかな……
records.en_original: What to do with all these seeds...
records.en_auxiliary: What to do with all these seeds...
records.en: What should I do with those plant seeds I found outside...

records.jp: キャンプファイヤーって、どんな感じなんだろう……
records.en_original: I wonder what it's like to build a bonfire...
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder what it's like to build a bonfire...
records.en: I wonder what a campfire is like...

records.jp: やっぱり、喫茶店には紅茶も欠かせませんよね
records.en_original: You can't have a coffee shop without tea!
records.en_auxiliary: You can't have a coffee shop without tea!
records.en: A café really does need tea too.

records.jp: わたしの料理……何かが足りない気がします
records.en_original: There's just something missing...
records.en_auxiliary: There's just something missing...
records.en: I feel like something's missing from my cooking.

records.jp: やあやあ、愛央さんや。^00ちょっと耳を貸してくれないかね？
records.en_original: Ao! Can I borrow you for a second?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao! Can I borrow you for a second?
records.en: Well, well, Ao-san.^00Could you lend me your ear for a moment?

records.jp: 元の世界に戻るための手がかり……^00もしかしたら、この学校の中にも何かあるかも。^00愛央ちゃんも手伝ってほしいのです
records.en_original: There may be clues that could help us return to the our world hidden somewhere in this school. Will you help me look, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: There may be clues that could help us return to the our world hidden somewhere in this school. Will you help me look, Ao?
records.en: A clue to returning to our original world...^00There may be something here in the school.^00I'd like you to help too, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 安全に探索するなら、もっと戦いに慣れないと。^00それこそ、金城さん一人守れるくらいにはね。^00……別に、探索するなら人手は多い方が良いってだけ
records.en_original: If you want to explore safely, you need to get used to fighting. You should at least be able to protect Yuki by yourself. ...Besides, if you're going to go exploring, it's better to go in a group.
records.en_auxiliary: If you want to explore safely, you need to get used to fighting. You should at least be able to protect Yuki by yourself. ...Besides, if you're going to go exploring, it's better to go in a group.
records.en: If we're going to explore safely, you need more combat experience.^00Enough to protect Kinjou-san on your own, at least.^00...It's not like that. Exploring is simply safer with more people.

records.jp: 手が空いてるならちょっと食事の準備手伝ってよ！^00愛央はサンドイッチ係ね！
records.en_original: If you have a moment, help me with the cooking! You're in charge of sandwiches, Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: If you have a moment, help me with the cooking! You're in charge of sandwiches, Ao!
records.en: If you're free, help me get dinner ready!^00You're on sandwich duty, Ao!

records.jp: たくさん雨を溜めておける容器を作れば、^00少しはマシになるんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: What if we made some kind of container that could hold rain water? Wouldn't that fix things?
records.en_auxiliary: What if we made some kind of container that could hold rain water? Wouldn't that fix things?
records.en: What if we made a container that could hold lots of rainwater?^00That might improve things a little.

records.jp: 廊下が濡れっぱなしなのも危ないから、^00とにかく拭き掃除はしておいた方が良いと思う。^00タオルなら、確か<CLRE>更衣室<CLNR>に……
records.en_original: Someone could slip on the wet floor in the hallway. I think we should probably wipe it up. I think there were some towels in the <CLRE>Locker Room<CLNR>...
records.en_auxiliary: Someone could slip on the wet floor in the hallway. I think we should probably wipe it up. I think there were some towels in the <CLRE>Locker Room<CLNR>...
records.en: It's dangerous to leave the hallway soaked,^00so I think we should wipe it down first.^00There should be some towels in the <CLRE>Locker Room<CLNR>...

records.jp: 雨を防ぐには傘だよ傘！^00<CLRE>下駄箱<CLNR>の方に余ってる傘があるからとってきてよ！
records.en_original: All we need is an umbrella for that rain! There's an extra one near the <CLRE>shoe rack<CLNR>. Go get it!
records.en_auxiliary: All we need is an umbrella for that rain! There's an extra one near the <CLRE>shoe rack<CLNR>. Go get it!
records.en: If we want to keep out the rain, we need umbrellas!^00There are some spares by the <CLRE>shoe lockers<CLNR>, so go get them!

records.jp: たこ焼きならわたし、昔作ったことあるんだ。^00屋台からただようソースの香ばしい香り……^00想像しただけでお腹空いてきちゃうね
records.en_original: I made takoyaki once a long time ago. I can still smell the sweet sauce wafting from the stand... I'm getting hungry just thinking about it.
records.en_auxiliary: I made takoyaki once a long time ago. I can still smell the sweet sauce wafting from the stand... I'm getting hungry just thinking about it.
records.en: I've made takoyaki before.^00That savory sauce drifting from a festival stall...^00Just imagining it is making me hungry.

records.jp: サバイバルにおいて娯楽は最重要課題だよ！^00あたしたちの手で遊びを開発していこ！
records.en_original: Entertainment is vital to survival! We need to come up with new ways to stay entertained!
records.en_auxiliary: Entertainment is vital to survival! We need to come up with new ways to stay entertained!
records.en: Entertainment is essential to survival!^00Let's invent some fun of our own!

records.jp: もし学校に電車の駅があったら……なんて^00考えたことはないですか？^00こういう場所だからこそ……^00たまにはそんな夢を見るのも良いと思うんです
records.en_original: Have you ever wondered what it would be like if the train stopped directly at the school? I love thinking about things like that.
records.en_auxiliary: Have you ever wondered what it would be like if the train stopped directly at the school? I love thinking about things like that.
records.en: Have you ever imagined^00a train station right here at the school?^00In a place like this...^00I think it's nice to dream sometimes.

records.jp: 雨漏り対策かあ……
records.en_original: What to do about that leaky roof...
records.en_auxiliary: What to do about that leaky roof...
records.en: What to do about that leaky roof...

records.jp: 雨漏り対策ねえ……
records.en_original: Something needs to be done about that leak...
records.en_auxiliary: Something needs to be done about that leak...
records.en: Something needs to be done about that leak...

records.jp: 雨漏り対策……んんっ！？^00なんか今アイディア降りてきたかも！
records.en_original: The leak in the roof... Wait! I might have a good idea!
records.en_auxiliary: The leak in the roof... Wait! I might have a good idea!
records.en: The leaking roof... Huh?!^00I think an idea just came to me!

records.jp: 夜の学校って、ちょっと暗くて危ないよね……
records.en_original: The school gets so dark at night, you have to be careful...
records.en_auxiliary: The school gets so dark at night, you have to be careful...
records.en: The school is so dark at night that it feels a little dangerous...

records.jp: 夜の学校って、ちょっと暗くて危ないよね。^00灯りを増やしたいけど、^00せっかくなら石灯籠を作るのはどうかな？^00本物の火の灯りって、ちょっとホッとするよね
records.en_original: The school is dangerous at night with how dark it gets. What do you think about making some stone lanterns? There's something reassuring about the light from a real fire.
records.en_auxiliary: The school is dangerous at night with how dark it gets. What do you think about making some stone lanterns? There's something reassuring about the light from a real fire.
records.en: The school is dark and a little dangerous at night.^00I'd like to add more lights,^00but why not make stone lanterns while we're at it?^00There's something comforting about real firelight.

records.jp: うーん……どうしようかなあ
records.en_original: Hmm... I don't know...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I don't know...
records.en: Hmm... I don't know...

records.jp: 食料にはまだ余裕があるけど、^00人も増えてきたし、余裕をもって蓄えておきたいよね。^00愛央ちゃんも手伝ってくれる？
records.en_original: We still have plenty of food, but with more and more people coming, I want to make sure we have enough stored. Ao, can you help?
records.en_auxiliary: We still have plenty of food, but with more and more people coming, I want to make sure we have enough stored. Ao, can you help?
records.en: We still have plenty of food,^00but there are more of us now, so we should keep a generous reserve.^00Will you help too, Ao-chan?

records.jp: もったいないことしちゃった……
records.en_original: What a waste...
records.en_auxiliary: What a waste...
records.en: What a waste...

records.jp: せっかく集めた食材を腐らせちゃった……^00ちゃんと保存が効くものも用意しておきたいよね。^00食料集め、手伝ってもらえる？
records.en_original: All the ingredients we gathered went bad... I'll make sure prepare them so they'll keep longer. Can you help me gather some more ingredients?
records.en_auxiliary: All the ingredients we gathered went bad... I'll make sure prepare them so they'll keep longer. Can you help me gather some more ingredients?
records.en: The ingredients we worked so hard to gather went bad...^00We should prepare some food that keeps properly too.^00Could you help me gather more?

records.jp: やっぱり……やっぱりアレがないと
records.en_original: That's it...! That's what we need.
records.en_auxiliary: That's it...! That's what we need.
records.en: That's it...! That's what we need.

records.jp: やっぱり、生きていくにはお米。お米だよ。^00学校の中でお米を育てられたら、^00暮らしがぐっと豊かになるはずだよ！
records.en_original: It's just not living without rice. If we could grow rice inside the school, our quality of life would improve dramatically!
records.en_auxiliary: It's just not living without rice. If we could grow rice inside the school, our quality of life would improve dramatically!
records.en: When it comes to living, you need rice. Rice.^00If we could grow it right here at school,^00our lives would be much richer!

records.jp: 学校に流れている電気……^00尽きることはないのかな
records.en_original: I wonder if the school will ever run out of electricity...
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder if the school will ever run out of electricity...
records.en: I wonder if the school electricity^00will ever run out...

records.jp: 非常時に備えて、緊急用の発電装置とか、^00作ってみてもいいかもね。^00風力発電なら、仕組みも分かりやすいし……^00何とかなるんじゃないかな
records.en_original: It might not be a bad idea to build some kind of emergency power generator just in case. A wind turbine is fairly simple... I'm sure we could put something together.
records.en_auxiliary: It might not be a bad idea to build some kind of emergency power generator just in case. A wind turbine is fairly simple... I'm sure we could put something together.
records.en: Maybe we should build an emergency generator^00in case something happens.^00A wind turbine is easy enough to understand...^00I think we could manage it.

records.jp: これからの戦いに備えて、もっと鍛えないと……
records.en_original: I need to get stronger...
records.en_auxiliary: I need to get stronger...
records.en: I need to get stronger...

records.jp: 学校に侵入してきたやつ、かなりの強敵だった。^00これからの戦いに備えて、^00私たちももっと鍛える必要があると思う。^00星崎さんも付き合ってくれる？
records.en_original: That thing was quite powerful. I think we need to train more to prepare for future battles. Will you train with me, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: That thing was quite powerful. I think we need to train more to prepare for future battles. Will you train with me, Ao?
records.en: That thing that invaded the school was extremely powerful.^00To prepare for the battles ahead,^00I think we need to train even more.^00Will you join me, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: そろそろ大きな戦いがありそうだね。^00やれることは、やっておこう
records.en_original: There's a big battle coming. We should do what we can while there's still time.
records.en_auxiliary: There's a big battle coming. We should do what we can while there's still time.
records.en: A big battle may be coming soon.^00Let's do everything we can while we have time.

records.jp: 世界を相手にするんだから、^00どんな戦いになるかわからない……^00できる準備は万全にしておきたい。^00今よりもっと強くなるために
records.en_original: We have no idea what fighting against the very world itself will be like. We have to prepare to gain any advantage we can.
records.en_auxiliary: We have no idea what fighting against the very world itself will be like. We have to prepare to gain any advantage we can.
records.en: We're going up against the world itself,^00so we don't know what kind of battle this will be...^00I want us to prepare as thoroughly as possible.^00So we can become even stronger.

records.jp: たまには、一人でゆっくりすごす時間も欲しい……
records.en_original: Sometimes I'd prefer to relax alone...
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes I'd prefer to relax alone...
records.en: Sometimes I'd prefer to relax alone...

records.jp: この生活が苦痛っていうわけじゃないけど、^00もっと一人になれる時間も欲しいんだよね。^00テントっていうのは、悪くない案かも
records.en_original: Living here isn't particularly hard, but I would prefer some alone time occasionally. A tent might not be a bad idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Living here isn't particularly hard, but I would prefer some alone time occasionally. A tent might not be a bad idea.
records.en: Living here isn't bad,^00but I'd like a little more time to myself.^00A tent might not be a bad idea.

records.jp: せっかく作ったものを人に見てもらいたい、^00っていうのは、ごくごく自然だよね。うん
records.en_original: It's normal to want people to see the things you've created, isn't it? Yes, it must be.
records.en_auxiliary: It's normal to want people to see the things you've created, isn't it? Yes, it must be.
records.en: It's only natural to want people to see^00something you worked hard to make. Yeah.

records.jp: せっかく作った同人誌……どうせなら、^00人に見てもらえる場所があったらいいなって。^00そこまで派手にしなくていいから、^00ふらっと立ち寄って見てもらえるくらいでいいんだけど
records.en_original: It would be nice to have a place where people can see the comics I've drawn. It doesn't have to be nice, just a place where people can stop and browse.
records.en_auxiliary: It would be nice to have a place where people can see the comics I've drawn. It doesn't have to be nice, just a place where people can stop and browse.
records.en: I worked hard on this doujinshi...^00It would be nice to have somewhere people could see it.^00It doesn't need to be flashy,^00just a place they can casually stop by and read.

records.jp: はあ……。やっぱりわたし一人じゃ……
records.en_original: *Sigh*... I can't do it alone...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*... I can't do it alone...
records.en: *Sigh*... I can't do it alone...

records.jp: 食材集めのためにモンスター退治をしたいんですけど、^00わたし、戦いにはあまり自信がなくて……。^00もしよかったら、一緒に来ていただけませんか？
records.en_original: I'd like to defeat some demons for materials, but I'm not very confident in my fighting skills... Do you think you could come with me?
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like to defeat some demons for materials, but I'm not very confident in my fighting skills... Do you think you could come with me?
records.en: I'd like to defeat some monsters to gather ingredients,^00but I'm not very confident in battle...^00Would you mind coming with me?

records.jp: 時々、わたしの家があった商店街のことを思い出します
records.en_original: Every now and again I think about the shopping street my house was.
records.en_auxiliary: Every now and again I think about the shopping street my house was.
records.en: Sometimes I remember the shopping street where I lived.

records.jp: 時々、わたしの家があった商店街のことを思い出します^00あのゲートを見るたびに「ああ、帰ってきたんだ」って^00安心できる場所でした
records.en_original: Every now and again I think about the shopping street my house was. It feels like I'm back home whenever I see that gate.
records.en_auxiliary: Every now and again I think about the shopping street my house was. It feels like I'm back home whenever I see that gate.
records.en: Sometimes I remember the shopping street where I lived.^00Every time I saw that gate, I could think, 'I'm home,'^00and feel at ease.

records.jp: せっかくだし、夏らしいことしたいよね
records.en_original: We should do something summery while we're here.
records.en_auxiliary: We should do something summery while we're here.
records.en: We should do something summery while we're here.

records.jp: 真夏みたいに暑い日が続くけど……^00どうせなら夏らしいことしたいよね。^00夏と言えばやっぱり花火かな？^00手作りするの難しそうだけど、きっと楽しいと思う
records.en_original: We should take advantage of the heat and do something summer. Nothing says summer like fireworks, don't you think? It might be tough to make them ourselves, but I bet we'd have fun.
records.en_auxiliary: We should take advantage of the heat and do something summer. Nothing says summer like fireworks, don't you think? It might be tough to make them ourselves, but I bet we'd have fun.
records.en: The days keep feeling like midsummer...^00We might as well do something summery.^00Summer means fireworks, right?^00Making them ourselves sounds hard, but fun.

records.jp: んー……まだちょっとキレが悪いなあ
records.en_original: Hmm.. Still feel kind of stiff.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm.. Still feel kind of stiff.
records.en: Hmm... My movements still aren't quite sharp enough.

records.jp: モンスターと戦う時、^00まだちょっと動きに違和感があるんだよね。^00また、練習に付き合ってもらえない？
records.en_original: I still feel a little stiff when fighting. Would you come practice with me again?
records.en_auxiliary: I still feel a little stiff when fighting. Would you come practice with me again?
records.en: When I fight monsters,^00my movements still feel a little off.^00Would you practice with me again?

records.jp: 最近、ものが増えてきたよね……
records.en_original: Where is all this stuff coming from...?
records.en_auxiliary: Where is all this stuff coming from...?
records.en: We've been accumulating a lot of stuff lately...

records.jp: ものが増えてきたけど、^00そろそろ置く場所にも困るようになってきたね。^00収納できるスペースを作っておいた方が良さそう。^00あまり大きいのは無理だと思うけど……
records.en_original: We're gonna run out of space if we keep getting new things. Might be a good idea to make some kind of storage space. Can't be too big though...
records.en_auxiliary: We're gonna run out of space if we keep getting new things. Might be a good idea to make some kind of storage space. Can't be too big though...
records.en: We've accumulated a lot of things,^00and we're starting to run out of places to put them.^00We should probably make some storage space.^00Though I don't think it can be very large...

records.jp: ふうー……
records.en_original: Phew...
records.en_auxiliary: Phew...
records.en: Phew...

records.jp: ふうー……^00心配してくれてありがとね、愛央ちゃん。^00慣れない環境のせいか、ちょっと疲れ気味なのかも。^00校舎の中で、静かに休める場所ってないかなあ？
records.en_original: Phew... Thanks for worrying about me, Ao. I guess I'm still not used to this place. Is there somewhere in the school I can rest?
records.en_auxiliary: Phew... Thanks for worrying about me, Ao. I guess I'm still not used to this place. Is there somewhere in the school I can rest?
records.en: Phew...^00Thanks for worrying about me, Ao-chan.^00Maybe this unfamiliar environment is wearing me out.^00Is there somewhere quiet inside the school where I can rest?

records.jp: 戦いに慣れておきたいよね
records.en_original: I wanna get used to fighting.
records.en_auxiliary: I wanna get used to fighting.
records.en: I wanna get used to fighting.

records.jp: みんなの足を引っ張らないように。^00ここでの戦いに慣れておきたいんだよね。^00ちょっと付き合ってもらえないかな？
records.en_original: I wanna get used to fighting here so I don't slow everyone down. Will you come with me?
records.en_auxiliary: I wanna get used to fighting here so I don't slow everyone down. Will you come with me?
records.en: I don't want to hold everyone back.^00I'd like to get used to fighting here.^00Would you practice with me for a bit?

records.jp: うーん……何がいいかなぁ……
records.en_original: Hmm... Which one should I go with...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Which one should I go with...
records.en: Hmm... What would be good...

records.jp: 最近のお姉ちゃん、疲れが溜まってるみたいで……。^00甘いものとか差し入れしてあげたいんだけど、^00何をあげたらいいのか悩んじゃって。^00愛央ちゃん、何かいい案ないかなあ？
records.en_original: Mio seems tired lately... I'm thinking about giving her something sweet to eat, but I can't think of what. Do you have any suggestions, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Mio seems tired lately... I'm thinking about giving her something sweet to eat, but I can't think of what. Do you have any suggestions, Ao?
records.en: Onee-chan seems exhausted lately...^00I'd like to bring her something sweet,^00but I can't decide what.^00Do you have any ideas, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 夢を見たんだ。懐かしい夢……
records.en_original: I had a dream last night. It's like I was there again...
records.en_auxiliary: I had a dream last night. It's like I was there again...
records.en: I had a nostalgic dream...

records.jp: 昔、お姉ちゃんと、お母さんと、^00三人でお祭りに行ったことがあってね。^00縁日の屋台で遊んだりして、すごく楽しかったんだ。^00ここにもそういう屋台があったら楽しそうだよね。^00例えば……金魚すくいとか！
records.en_original: A long time ago I went to a festival with my mom and Mio. We had so much fun at all the activity booths. Wouldn't it be fun if we built some ourselves? Like goldfish scooping!
records.en_auxiliary: A long time ago I went to a festival with my mom and Mio. We had so much fun at all the activity booths. Wouldn't it be fun if we built some ourselves? Like goldfish scooping!
records.en: A long time ago, Onee-chan, Mom, and I^00went to a festival together.^00We played at the festival stalls and had so much fun.^00It would be nice to have stalls like that here too.^00For example... goldfish scooping!

records.jp: 何を使うのが良いかなあ……
records.en_original: What should I use...
records.en_auxiliary: What should I use...
records.en: What should I use...

records.jp: お姉ちゃんにお守り代わりに^00アクセサリーでもプレゼントしようと思うんだけど、^00何か材料になりそうなものないかなあ？^00例えばモンスターが持ってる素材とか……
records.en_original: I'm thinking of giving Mio some kind of accessory instead of a charm. Is there anything I could use to make it? I wonder if demons have materials I could use for it...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm thinking of giving Mio some kind of accessory instead of a charm. Is there anything I could use to make it? I wonder if demons have materials I could use for it...
records.en: I'm thinking of giving Onee-chan^00an accessory to serve as a good-luck charm.^00Do we have anything that could work as material?^00Maybe something a monster carries...

records.jp: ふー……今日も暑いねえ
records.en_original: Phew... Sure is hot.
records.en_auxiliary: Phew... Sure is hot.
records.en: Phew... It's so hot out today...

records.jp: ふー……今日も暑いねえ。^00こう暑い日が続くと汗もたくさんかいて大変だよね。^00いつでも汗を流せるように、^00屋外シャワーを設置してみるのはどうかな？
records.en_original: Phew... Sure is hot. I bet everyone's tired of being all sweaty all the time. Wouldn't it be nice to have a shower outside so we could refresh anytime?
records.en_auxiliary: Phew... Sure is hot. I bet everyone's tired of being all sweaty all the time. Wouldn't it be nice to have a shower outside so we could refresh anytime?
records.en: Phew... It's hot again today.^00Days this hot leave everyone drenched in sweat.^00How about installing an outdoor shower^00so we can wash it off whenever we want?

records.jp: 夏っぽいことってなんだろう……
records.en_original: What's a good thing to do during the summer...
records.en_auxiliary: What's a good thing to do during the summer...
records.en: What's a good thing to do during the summer...

records.jp: 夏の遊びといえば……キャンプとかどうかな？^00外で座ってまったりくつろいだり、^00バーベキューしたり……。^00絶対楽しいと思う！
records.en_original: What's a good thing to do during the summer... Ooh, what about a bonfire! We could all sit around it and have a barbecue! That sounds like a ton of fun!
records.en_auxiliary: What's a good thing to do during the summer... Ooh, what about a bonfire! We could all sit around it and have a barbecue! That sounds like a ton of fun!
records.en: When it comes to summer fun... how about camping?^00We could sit outside and relax,^00have a barbecue...^00It would definitely be fun!

records.jp: 真っ白い壁を見てると……いひひ
records.en_original: Every time I look at that wall I can feel my creativity surging... Heehee...
records.en_auxiliary: Every time I look at that wall I can feel my creativity surging... Heehee...
records.en: When I look at a pure white wall... heehee.

records.jp: 真っ白い校舎を見てると、^00またあたしの内なる芸術の心がうずく……！^00あれをキャンバスに絵を描いたら^00すっごく楽しいだろうなあ……^00急いで画材を調達しないと！
records.en_original: Every time I look at that wall I can feel my creativity surging... I can't let that beautiful canvas continue on being blank! I need painting supplies ASAP!
records.en_auxiliary: Every time I look at that wall I can feel my creativity surging... I can't let that beautiful canvas continue on being blank! I need painting supplies ASAP!
records.en: Looking at the pure white school building^00makes my inner artist itch again...!^00It would be so much fun^00to use it as a canvas...^00I need to get some art supplies, quick!

records.jp: 夏らしいもの……もっと欲しいよね
records.en_original: We need some more summery stuff...
records.en_auxiliary: We need some more summery stuff...
records.en: We need some more summery stuff...

records.jp: 夏らしいものといえば、やっぱりお祭りの屋台！^00かわいくて、写真映えしそうで、おいしいやつ……^00ときたら、りんご飴しかないっしょ！^00早速作ろうよ！
records.en_original: Nothing says summer like festival stands! They're cute, they make for great pictures, and the food...! I gotta have a candy apple now... Let's make some!
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing says summer like festival stands! They're cute, they make for great pictures, and the food...! I gotta have a candy apple now... Let's make some!
records.en: Nothing says summer like festival stalls!^00Something cute, photogenic, and delicious...^00That has to mean candy apples!^00Let's make some right away!

records.jp: ちょっと欲しいものがあってさ……
records.en_original: There's something I kinda want...
records.en_auxiliary: There's something I kinda want...
records.en: There's something I kinda want...

records.jp: 戦いがどんどん激しくなってきて、^00あたしも何か力になれたらって思うんだけど……。^00せめて、護身用のアイテムがあれば、^00少しでも力になれたり……しないかな？
records.en_original: With the battles getting more and more thought, I wish there was something more I could do to help... If I at least had some kind of self-defense tool maybe I could fight...?
records.en_auxiliary: With the battles getting more and more thought, I wish there was something more I could do to help... If I at least had some kind of self-defense tool maybe I could fight...?
records.en: The battles keep getting more intense,^00and I want to help somehow...^00If I at least had something for self-defense,^00maybe I could be of some use...?

records.jp: うーむ……水……
records.en_original: Hmm... Water...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Water...
records.en: Hmm... Water...

records.jp: ふと、頭の中に浮かんだ。^00水……四角い水……。^00きららはきっと、そこに行かなければならない。^00愛央は心当たり、ある？
records.en_original: It suddenly popped into my head. Rectangular water... I have to go somewhere where there's rectangular water... Do you have any idea what it means, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: It suddenly popped into my head. Rectangular water... I have to go somewhere where there's rectangular water... Do you have any idea what it means, Ao?
records.en: It suddenly came to Kirara.^00Water... square water...^00Kirara is sure she must go there.^00Ao, does that mean anything to you?

records.jp: このままだとよくないことが起こる……
records.en_original: Something terrible will happen if we don't do something...
records.en_auxiliary: Something terrible will happen if we don't do something...
records.en: Something terrible will happen if we don't do something...

records.jp: 愛央。大変だ。^00今すぐ、あのモンスターを倒してほしい。^00そうしなければ、^00きららたちに良くないことが起こる……^00そんな予感がする
records.en_original: Ao, this is serious. I need you to destroy a demon for me right away. If you don't, something terrible will happen. I can feel it.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, this is serious. I need you to destroy a demon for me right away. If you don't, something terrible will happen. I can feel it.
records.en: Ao. This is serious.^00Kirara needs you to defeat that monster immediately.^00Otherwise,^00something bad will happen to all of us...^00Kirara has a feeling.

records.jp: 怪しい気配を感じる……
records.en_original: I sense a strange energy...
records.en_auxiliary: I sense a strange energy...
records.en: I sense a strange energy...

records.jp: 最近、ココロトープから怪しい気配を感じる。^00きっと、放っておくとまずいことになる。^00急いで調べに行くのが吉
records.en_original: I sense a strange energy coming from the Heartscape recently. Something terrible may happen if we don't do something soon. We best check it out soon.
records.en_auxiliary: I sense a strange energy coming from the Heartscape recently. Something terrible may happen if we don't do something soon. We best check it out soon.
records.en: Lately, Kirara has sensed something suspicious coming from the Heartscape.^00Leaving it alone will surely end badly.^00We should investigate at once.

records.jp: そういえば……ここにはアレがないな
records.en_original: I knew something was missing...
records.en_auxiliary: I knew something was missing...
records.en: I knew something was missing...

records.jp: ここには神様が住まうお社がない。^00家があると、神も喜ぶ。ぜひつくろう。^00もしかすると、また神の声を聞けるように^00なるかもしれないな……
records.en_original: There's no shrine for the gods to reside here. If we built them a home, I'm sure they'd be happy. I may even be able to hear the Divine again...
records.en_auxiliary: There's no shrine for the gods to reside here. If we built them a home, I'm sure they'd be happy. I may even be able to hear the Divine again...
records.en: There is no shrine here for the Divine to dwell in.^00A home would please the Divine. We should build one.^00Then Kirara may even be able^00to hear the voice of the Divine again...

records.jp: むう……黒い……影……
records.en_original: Mm... That shadow...
records.en_auxiliary: Mm... That shadow...
records.en: Mm... That shadow...

records.jp: ここ最近、きららの夢に謎の黒い影が現れ、^00すごい勢いできららを追ってくるのだ。^00おかげで最近寝不足で……すう……^00……はっ！　とにかく、調べてきてほしい
records.en_original: Recently I've been seeing a mysterious shadow in my dreams. It pursues me with incredible speed. Thanks to this, I haven't been getting any sle— ...*snore* ...Huh?! A-anyways, please look into it.
records.en_auxiliary: Recently I've been seeing a mysterious shadow in my dreams. It pursues me with incredible speed. Thanks to this, I haven't been getting any sle— ...*snore* ...Huh?! A-anyways, please look into it.
records.en: A mysterious black shadow has been appearing in Kirara's dreams,^00chasing Kirara at incredible speed.^00Kirara hasn't been sleeping well because of it... Zzz...^00...Huh! Anyway, Kirara wants you to investigate.

records.jp: そうだ。この世界にはアレが必要だ
records.en_original: Of course. That's what this world needs!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. That's what this world needs!
records.en: Of course. That's what this world needs!

records.jp: 丸くて穴の空いたものを作ってほしい。^00この世界にはきっとそれが必要だ。^00……井戸？　なるほど、井戸か。^00それなら条件は満たしそうだ。れっつめいきんぐ
records.en_original: I want you to build something round with a hole in it. That's exactly what this world needs. ...A well? Yes, that should work perfectly. There's no tie to lose.
records.en_auxiliary: I want you to build something round with a hole in it. That's exactly what this world needs. ...A well? Yes, that should work perfectly. There's no tie to lose.
records.en: Kirara wants you to make something round with a hole.^00This world surely needs one.^00...A well? I see. A well.^00That should satisfy the conditions. Let's make it.

records.jp: おすすめしたい作品がある
records.en_original: I've got a recommendation for you.
records.en_auxiliary: I've got a recommendation for you.
records.en: I've got a recommendation for you.

records.jp: きららのコレクションの中に^00愛央にもぜひ見て欲しい名作映画がある。^00けど、映画を見るための器材がない……。^00せっかくなら本格的なシアタールームを作らないか？
records.en_original: There's a masterpiece in my film collection that you have to see. The only problem is, we don't have the equipment to watch any... Wouldn't it be nice if we built a theater room?
records.en_auxiliary: There's a masterpiece in my film collection that you have to see. The only problem is, we don't have the equipment to watch any... Wouldn't it be nice if we built a theater room?
records.en: Among Kirara's collection^00is a classic film Kirara really wants Ao to see.^00But we don't have the equipment to watch it...^00Why not build a proper theater room?

records.jp: ……はあ。^00ま、考えても仕方ないか……
records.en_original: *Sigh*... Well, there's no use overthinking.
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*... Well, there's no use overthinking.
records.en: *Sigh*...^00Well, there's no use dwelling on it...

records.jp: 心配させてごめんなさい。^00ここに来てから、色々なことを考えてしまって。^00少しはリラックスする時間も取りたいところだけど……^00どこかいい場所はある？
records.en_original: I'm sorry if I made you worry. I've had a lot on my mind ever since I came here. I wish I could go someone I could relax a bit... Do you know of anywhere?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry if I made you worry. I've had a lot on my mind ever since I came here. I wish I could go someone I could relax a bit... Do you know of anywhere?
records.en: Sorry for worrying you.^00I've had a lot on my mind since coming here.^00I should make some time to relax...^00Do you know anywhere suitable?

records.jp: 困ったわ……
records.en_original: What to do...
records.en_auxiliary: What to do...
records.en: What to do...

records.jp: 陽桜莉に料理をリクエストされたのだけど、^00材料を切らしてしまっていて……。^00食材の調達、お願いできる？^00豊かな食生活のためにも、ね？
records.en_original: Hiori asked me to cook something, but we're all out of ingredients... Could I ask you to gather some more for us? It's for the good of your own dinner as well.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori asked me to cook something, but we're all out of ingredients... Could I ask you to gather some more for us? It's for the good of your own dinner as well.
records.en: Hiori asked me to cook something,^00but I've run out of the ingredients...^00Could you gather some for me?^00It'll make our meals more varied too, right?

records.jp: この世界が水に囲まれてて、寂しく思うことはない？
records.en_original: This world is completely surrounded by water. Doesn't that make you feel a little lonely?
records.en_auxiliary: This world is completely surrounded by water. Doesn't that make you feel a little lonely?
records.en: Does being surrounded by water ever make you feel lonely?

records.jp: この世界が水に囲まれてて、寂しく思うことはない？^00この狭い学校の中でも……気休めでもいい、^00広い世界に想いを馳せることも大事だと思うの。^00そうね……例えば宇宙に関するものとかはどうかしら
records.en_original: This world is completely surrounded by water. Doesn't that make you feel a little lonely? This school may be small, but... I think it's important to think about the outside world. Like outer space!
records.en_auxiliary: This world is completely surrounded by water. Doesn't that make you feel a little lonely? This school may be small, but... I think it's important to think about the outside world. Like outer space!
records.en: Doesn't being surrounded by water ever make you feel lonely?^00Even in this cramped school... even if it's only a small comfort,^00I think it's important to imagine the wider world.^00Perhaps something related to outer space.

records.jp: どうしたものかしらね……
records.en_original: I wonder if there's anything I can do...
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder if there's anything I can do...
records.en: I wonder if there's anything I can do...

records.jp: ここでの生活が長引くと、陽桜莉が勉強したことを^00忘れたりしそうで心配。^00ここでも少しは勉強してもらいたいけれど……^00例えば、何かの実験をしてみるとか、ね。^00ちょっと愛央も手伝ってくれない？
records.en_original: The longer we stay here, the more I worry that Hiori will forget everything she's studied. If only there was some way she could study here...maybe a experiment of some kind. Ao, do you think you could help her?
records.en_auxiliary: The longer we stay here, the more I worry that Hiori will forget everything she's studied. If only there was some way she could study here...maybe a experiment of some kind. Ao, do you think you could help her?
records.en: If we stay here too long, I'm worried Hiori may^00forget what she's learned.^00I'd like her to study at least a little here...^00Perhaps by conducting some kind of experiment.^00Ao, could you help too?

records.jp: ちょっとお願いしたいことがあるのだけど……
records.en_original: I've got a small favor to ask...
records.en_auxiliary: I've got a small favor to ask...
records.en: I've got a small favor to ask...

records.jp: この間、陽桜莉がココロトープできれいな石を^00見つけたって見せてくれたの。^00私もその石が欲しいと思ったのだけど……^00もしよかったら、集めてきてもらえないかしら？^00……あの子にも、プレゼントしてあげたいし
records.en_original: Hiori showed me a beautiful stone she found in the Heartscape the other day. I'd love one of my own, but... Do you think you could collect some for you? I want to give her one as a present.
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori showed me a beautiful stone she found in the Heartscape the other day. I'd love one of my own, but... Do you think you could collect some for you? I want to give her one as a present.
records.en: The other day, Hiori showed me a beautiful stone^00she found in the Heartscape.^00I would like one too...^00Would you mind gathering some for me?^00...I'd like to give one to her as a present as well.

records.jp: 遊園地……懐かしいわね
records.en_original: An amusement park... How nostalgic.
records.en_auxiliary: An amusement park... How nostalgic.
records.en: An amusement park... How nostalgic.

records.jp: 昔、家族と一緒に遊園地に行ったことがあったわ。^00陽桜莉と一緒に、動物の乗り物に乗ったりして……^00あの時のことを思い出してみるのも、^00悪くないかもしれない
records.en_original: I went to an amusement park with my family a long time ago. Hiori and I rode a little carousel together... It may not be so bad to reminisce like this every now and again.
records.en_auxiliary: I went to an amusement park with my family a long time ago. Hiori and I rode a little carousel together... It may not be so bad to reminisce like this every now and again.
records.en: I once visited an amusement park with my family.^00Hiori and I rode the animal rides together...^00It might not be a bad idea^00to bring back a little of that memory.

records.jp: ……この世界の空はどうなっているのかしら
records.en_original: The sky here looks so real...
records.en_auxiliary: The sky here looks so real...
records.en: ...I wonder what the sky in this world really is.

records.jp: この世界の外に無が広がっているとしたら、^00この空は作り物ってことなのかしら。^00夜に見える星も、案外近くにあるのかもしれない。^00ロケットがあれば、^00それを確かめられるのかもしれないけれど……
records.en_original: If there is nothing beyond the border of this world, wouldn't that mean the sky is fake? The stars we see at night might be closer than we thing. If only we had a rocket, we could go see for ourselves.
records.en_auxiliary: If there is nothing beyond the border of this world, wouldn't that mean the sky is fake? The stars we see at night might be closer than we thing. If only we had a rocket, we could go see for ourselves.
records.en: If nothingness stretches beyond this world,^00does that mean this sky is artificial?^00Even the stars we see at night may be surprisingly close.^00If we had a rocket,^00perhaps we could find out...

records.jp: すみません、お願いがあるのですが
records.en_original: Pardon me, but I have a favor to ask.
records.en_auxiliary: Pardon me, but I have a favor to ask.
records.en: Pardon me, but I have a favor to ask.

records.jp: 花壇のお手入れをしていると、^00雑草とそうでないものとの区別がつかなくて……。^00どうやって見分けたら良いのでしょうか？
records.en_original: I've been tending the flower bed, but I can't tell the difference between what's a weed and what isn't while they're growing... How can I spot the difference?
records.en_auxiliary: I've been tending the flower bed, but I can't tell the difference between what's a weed and what isn't while they're growing... How can I spot the difference?
records.en: While tending the flower bed,^00I can't tell the weeds from the other plants...^00How can I tell them apart?

records.jp: 少し相談があるのですが……
records.en_original: There's a matter I wish to discuss with you...
records.en_auxiliary: There's a matter I wish to discuss with you...
records.en: There's a matter I wish to discuss with you...

records.jp: 皆さんと一緒に生活するうえで、^00私も何かお役に立てればと思うのですが……^00……なるほど、料理ですか。^00あまり自信はないですが、挑戦してみます
records.en_original: I'd like to find a way for me to be useful to everyone in our life here. ...Cooking, you say? I'm not very confident in my abilities, but I'll try my best.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like to find a way for me to be useful to everyone in our life here. ...Cooking, you say? I'm not very confident in my abilities, but I'll try my best.
records.en: As we all live together,^00I'd like to find some way to help...^00...I see. Cooking.^00I'm not very confident, but I will try.

records.jp: この間はありがとうございました
records.en_original: Thank you for before.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you for before.
records.en: Thank you for your help the other day.

records.jp: この間の料理の件、ありがとうございました。^00あれから料理のことを調べているのですが、^00もっと色々な食材を使ってみたいんです。^00もしよければ、集めてきてもらえないでしょうか
records.en_original: Thank you for your cooking suggestion earlier. I've begun to read up on the subject, and I would like to try using some different ingredients. Do you think you could gather some for me?
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you for your cooking suggestion earlier. I've begun to read up on the subject, and I would like to try using some different ingredients. Do you think you could gather some for me?
records.en: Thank you for helping me with the cooking the other day.^00I've been studying cooking since then,^00and I would like to try using more varied ingredients.^00Would you mind gathering some for me?

records.jp: ……今日も日差しが強いですね
records.en_original: It's quite warm today, isn't it...
records.en_auxiliary: It's quite warm today, isn't it...
records.en: ...The sunlight is intense again today.

records.jp: いつも夏らしい日差しばかりだと、^00少し疲れてしまいますね。^00もっと、秋の夕暮れのような……^00淡く、ほっとする灯りがあると良いかもしれません
records.en_original: It's quite warm today, isn't it...? It can be tiring being in the sun all day. It would be nice to have a softer, more comforting light, like a nice autumn's twilight.
records.en_auxiliary: It's quite warm today, isn't it...? It can be tiring being in the sun all day. It would be nice to have a softer, more comforting light, like a nice autumn's twilight.
records.en: Being under the same midsummer sun every day^00can become rather tiring.^00A softer, comforting light...^00like an autumn sunset might be nice.

records.jp: 料理にもだいぶ慣れてきました
records.en_original: I've gotten more used to cooking.
records.en_auxiliary: I've gotten more used to cooking.
records.en: I've gotten more used to cooking.

records.jp: 星崎さんや、みなさんのおかげで、^00料理の腕も上がってきたように思います。^00そろそろ、お手伝いするだけでなく、^00自分で一から料理をしてみたいのですが……^00メニューのアイデアを頂けませんか？
records.en_original: I've gotten much better at cooking thanks to everyone's help. I should be able to start cooking from scratch myself rather than just helping. Do you have any ideas for what I should make?
records.en_auxiliary: I've gotten much better at cooking thanks to everyone's help. I should be able to start cooking from scratch myself rather than just helping. Do you have any ideas for what I should make?
records.en: Thanks to you and everyone else, Hoshizaki-san,^00I believe my cooking has improved.^00Rather than merely helping,^00I would like to cook something from scratch myself...^00Could you suggest a dish?

records.jp: ピアノの音……つい耳を澄ませてしまいます
records.en_original: The sound of a piano always makes me stop and listen.
records.en_auxiliary: The sound of a piano always makes me stop and listen.
records.en: The sound of a piano always makes me stop and listen.

records.jp: 時々、スピーカーから流れてくるピアノの音。^00ついつい耳を澄ませてしまいます。^00もし、生の音が聞けたら、とても素敵だと思います
records.en_original: I always stop and listen when ever I hear a piano over the speakers. It must sound even more wonderful in real life.
records.en_auxiliary: I always stop and listen when ever I hear a piano over the speakers. It must sound even more wonderful in real life.
records.en: Whenever piano music plays from the speakers,^00I can't help but stop and listen.^00Hearing a live performance would be wonderful.

records.jp: 心が休まるもの……。そういえば昔……
records.en_original: Something comforting... That reminds me...
records.en_auxiliary: Something comforting... That reminds me...
records.en: Something comforting... That reminds me...

records.jp: 昔、好きだったくまのぬいぐるみがあったんです。^00いつの間にか捨てられていましたが……。^00もしかしたら、子供の頃の私にとっては、^00それが心休まるものだったのかもしれません
records.en_original: I once had a stuffed bear I loved when I was a child. It got thrown away at some point, but I'm sure I found it comforting.
records.en_auxiliary: I once had a stuffed bear I loved when I was a child. It got thrown away at some point, but I'm sure I found it comforting.
records.en: I once had a stuffed bear I loved.^00It was thrown away before I knew it...^00Perhaps, when I was a child,^00it was something that brought me peace.

records.jp: 音楽を楽しめることは、とても贅沢なことですね
records.en_original: It would be a great luxury to be able to enjoy music.
records.en_auxiliary: It would be a great luxury to be able to enjoy music.
records.en: It would be a great luxury to be able to enjoy music.

records.jp: 音楽を楽しむ時間というのは、とても贅沢なものです。^00ライブや、コンサートといったものは^00経験がありませんが……^00一度は体験してみたいような気もします
records.en_original: Having the time to enjoy listening to music is such a luxurious thing. I've never been to a concert or a peformance, but I've always wanted to experience it at least once.
records.en_auxiliary: Having the time to enjoy listening to music is such a luxurious thing. I've never been to a concert or a peformance, but I've always wanted to experience it at least once.
records.en: Having time to enjoy music is a true luxury.^00I've never experienced anything^00like a live show or a concert...^00I think I'd like to at least once.

records.jp: んー……探しに行かないとなあ
records.en_original: Hmm... guess we need to go and search for it.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... guess we need to go and search for it.
records.en: Hmm... guess we need to go and search for it.

records.jp: ライムがココロトープにスマホを^00落としてきちゃったらしくて……。^00愛央も探すの手伝ってもらえないかな？
records.en_original: Apparently Lime dropped her smartphone in the Heartscape... Could you help us look?
records.en_auxiliary: Apparently Lime dropped her smartphone in the Heartscape... Could you help us look?
records.en: It seems Lime dropped her smartphone^00in the Heartscape...^00Ao, could you help us look for it?

records.jp: うーん……どこにいっちゃったんだろう
records.en_original: Ungh... wonder where it could be?
records.en_auxiliary: Ungh... wonder where it could be?
records.en: Hmm... Where could it have gone?

records.jp: この間、ココロトープに行った時に、^00化粧ポーチを落としてきちゃったみたいなんだよね。^00探すの手伝ってくれると嬉しいな
records.en_original: I seem to have dropped my makeup pouch when we visited the Heartscape. I'd really appreciate it if you helped me look for it.
records.en_auxiliary: I seem to have dropped my makeup pouch when we visited the Heartscape. I'd really appreciate it if you helped me look for it.
records.en: It seems I dropped my makeup pouch^00when we visited the Heartscape the other day.^00I'd appreciate your help finding it.

records.jp: ちょっと、頼みたいことがあるんだけど……
records.en_original: Umm... could I ask you a favor...?
records.en_auxiliary: Umm... could I ask you a favor...?
records.en: Umm... could I ask you a favor...?

records.jp: 私のココロトープの一番奥で見たあの景色……。^00どうしてもスケッチしたいの。^00ちょっと、一緒に来てもらえると助かる。^00こんなこと、星崎さんにしか頼めないから……
records.en_original: That scenery we saw in the deepest part of my Heartscape... I'd really like to make a sketch of it. Would you mind going there with me? You're the only one I can ask to help with these types of things...
records.en_auxiliary: That scenery we saw in the deepest part of my Heartscape... I'd really like to make a sketch of it. Would you mind going there with me? You're the only one I can ask to help with these types of things...
records.en: That view at the deepest point of my Heartscape...^00I desperately want to sketch it.^00It would help if you came with me.^00You're the only one I can ask, Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: ちょっと悩みを聞いて欲しいんだけど……
records.en_original: Could I ask you about something that's been weighing on my mind...?
records.en_auxiliary: Could I ask you about something that's been weighing on my mind...?
records.en: Could I ask you about something that's been weighing on my mind...?

records.jp: 伶那さんに、私の戦い方は危なっかしいって^00怒られちゃってさ……。^00戦うんだけじゃなくて、^00逃げる練習もした方がいいのかなあ。^00愛央ちゃん、ちょっと付き合ってくれる？
records.en_original: Rena got mad at me... She said my fighting style's too dangerous. So, instead of just practicing fighting, I'd like to also practice running away. Would you mind joining me, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Rena got mad at me... She said my fighting style's too dangerous. So, instead of just practicing fighting, I'd like to also practice running away. Would you mind joining me, Ao?
records.en: Rena-san scolded me because my fighting style^00looks too reckless...^00Maybe I should practice running away,^00not just fighting.^00Ao-chan, would you train with me?

records.jp: こころから聞いたんですけど……
records.en_original: So, I heard from Kokoro...
records.en_auxiliary: So, I heard from Kokoro...
records.en: So, I heard from Kokoro...

records.jp: わたしとこころが子どもの頃に作った秘密基地が^00ココロトープにあるんですよね。^00もしよければ、案内してもらえないでしょうか。^00こころに直接頼むのは、少し気恥ずかしくて……
records.en_original: You know that secret hideout in the Heartscape that Kokoro and I built when we were kids? If you don't mind, could you lead me to it? I'm kind of embarrassed to ask Kokoro...
records.en_auxiliary: You know that secret hideout in the Heartscape that Kokoro and I built when we were kids? If you don't mind, could you lead me to it? I'm kind of embarrassed to ask Kokoro...
records.en: The secret base Kokoro and I built as children^00exists in the Heartscape, doesn't it?^00Would you mind showing me the way?^00I'm a little embarrassed to ask Kokoro directly...

records.jp: 頼みたいことがあるんだけど！
records.en_original: I've got a favor to ask of you!
records.en_auxiliary: I've got a favor to ask of you!
records.en: I've got a favor to ask of you!

records.jp: この世界が終わる前にさ、^00もう一度、伶那と一緒にあの景色を見たい。^00危ないのは分かってるけど、でも……
records.en_original: Before this world ends, I'd like to see that scenery with Rena again. I know it's dangerous, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Before this world ends, I'd like to see that scenery with Rena again. I know it's dangerous, but...
records.en: Before this world ends,^00I want to see that view with Rena one more time.^00I know it's dangerous, but...

records.jp: もう一度、あの景色を……
records.en_original: I'd like to see that scenery, one more time...
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like to see that scenery, one more time...
records.en: I'd like to see that scenery, one more time...

records.jp: 記憶を取り戻してから、色々と考えていたんです。^00もう一度、今の私で^00ココロトープの景色を見てみたい……^00もしよければ、私を連れて行ってもらえないでしょうか
records.en_original: Ever since I got my memories back, I've been thinking about a lot of things. It's like I'm a new person, and I'd really like to see the Heartscape's scenery from my new perspective... Would you mind going there with me?
records.en_auxiliary: Ever since I got my memories back, I've been thinking about a lot of things. It's like I'm a new person, and I'd really like to see the Heartscape's scenery from my new perspective... Would you mind going there with me?
records.en: I've been thinking about many things since regaining my memories.^00I want to see the Heartscape again^00as the person I am now...^00Would you mind taking me there?

records.jp: 困ったわね……
records.en_original: Argh, it's no good...!
records.en_auxiliary: Argh, it's no good...!
records.en: This is a problem...

records.jp: 昔、陽桜莉に作ってあげてた料理のレシピが^00思い出せなくて困ってるの。^00ココロトープの中になら、^00もしかしたらヒントがあるかもしれないけれど……
records.en_original: I can't seem to remember that recipe Hiori made for me way back when. I wonder if there might be some kind of hint about it in the Heartscape...
records.en_auxiliary: I can't seem to remember that recipe Hiori made for me way back when. I wonder if there might be some kind of hint about it in the Heartscape...
records.en: I can't remember the recipe^00for a dish I used to make for Hiori.^00There may be some kind of clue^00inside the Heartscape...

records.jp: これはまずい……
records.en_original: This is bad...
records.en_auxiliary: This is bad...
records.en: This is bad...

records.jp: えまーじぇんしーえまーじぇんしー。^00きららのココロトープから、^00今までにない怪しい気配を感じる……。^00急いで調査に向かって欲しい。あ、きららもついていく
records.en_original: Emergency... emergency... I sense a strange energy in my Heartscape that wasn't there before. I'd like you to survey the situation at once. And take me with you.
records.en_auxiliary: Emergency... emergency... I sense a strange energy in my Heartscape that wasn't there before. I'd like you to survey the situation at once. And take me with you.
records.en: Emergency, emergency.^00Kirara senses a suspicious presence in Kirara's Heartscape,^00unlike anything there before...^00Please investigate at once. Oh, Kirara is coming too.

records.jp: たまにはだらだらくつろぎたいよねー
records.en_original: Sometimes I just want to kick back and relax!
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes I just want to kick back and relax!
records.en: Sometimes I just want to kick back and relax!

records.jp: たまにはだらだらくつろぎたいよねー^00でもそこら辺で寝転がるのはちょっとはばかられる……^00なら、そのための場所を作っちゃえばいいじゃん！^00心置きなくだらだらできる至高のゴロゴロ空間をさ！
records.en_original: Sometimes I just want to kick back and relax! But I don't want to nap over there... Sooo, we should make a place for us to be free and laze around all we want!
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes I just want to kick back and relax! But I don't want to nap over there... Sooo, we should make a place for us to be free and laze around all we want!
records.en: Sometimes you just want to laze around and relax.^00But it feels awkward to just lie down anywhere...^00Then let's build a place specifically for it!^00The ultimate lounging space, where we can laze around guilt-free!

records.jp: まだまだ満足してないよ！
records.en_original: I'm Not Done Yet!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm Not Done Yet!
records.en: I'm still not satisfied!

records.jp: これまで学校にいろんなものを建ててきたけど、^00まだまだ全然足りない！^00次なる学校魔改造計画のために、^00中庭を整地してスペースを確保するぞー！^00ってわけで、整地に必要な材料の確保、よろしく！
records.en_original: We may have built a lot of stuff on campus, but I'm not done yet! We need that space in the courtyard for the next part of our school makeover! That means we need you to get us some materials!
records.en_auxiliary: We may have built a lot of stuff on campus, but I'm not done yet! We need that space in the courtyard for the next part of our school makeover! That means we need you to get us some materials!
records.en: We've built all kinds of things around the school,^00but it's still nowhere near enough!^00For the next extreme school makeover,^00we're clearing the courtyard to make more room!^00So gather the materials we need to level the ground!

records.jp: 欲望ってどうして尽きないんだろうね？
records.en_original: Can't Get Enough!
records.en_auxiliary: Can't Get Enough!
records.en: Why do our desires never end?

records.jp: 中庭の方はだいぶ改造も進んできたけど、^00そうなると欲が出てくるのが人間ってもんだよ。^00ってわけで、校門の方もさらに改造していくよ！^00石造りだからちょっと大変かもだけど……^00とりあえず補修に必要なもの、集めてきて！
records.en_original: We've done well building up the courtyard, but I'm still not satisfied. And so, it's time for the gate next! It's gonna be tough with all that stone, but... Well, thanks in advance for the materials!
records.en_auxiliary: We've done well building up the courtyard, but I'm still not satisfied. And so, it's time for the gate next! It's gonna be tough with all that stone, but... Well, thanks in advance for the materials!
records.en: We've made a lot of progress remodeling the courtyard,^00but once that happens, people naturally want even more.^00So we're remodeling the school gate next!^00The stonework may make it tough...^00For now, gather what we need for the repairs!
